name: La_Plaga
negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, deformed, cartoon, anime, text, watermark
common_prompt: cinematic dark post-apocalyptic scene, horror atmosphere, muted desaturated colors, fog and smoke, dramatic lighting

scenes.name: executive_phone
scenes.prompt: a well-dressed Wall Street executive in an expensive suit sitting at a modern office desk, staring intently at his smartphone screen, city skyline visible through floor-to-ceiling windows behind him, cold blue office lighting, close-up shot

scenes.name: strange_glitch
scenes.prompt: close-up of a smartphone screen glitching with strange pulsating organic patterns, the executive's face illuminated by an eerie green light from the phone, his expression turning from confusion to fear, distorted reflections on the screen

scenes.name: virus_spreading_skin
scenes.prompt: a strange dark virus spreading from the smartphone onto the executive's hand, black veins crawling up his fingers and wrist, his skin turning grey and cracking, the phone still glowing with an unnatural light, extreme close-up of the infection spreading

scenes.name: transformation_begins
scenes.prompt: the executive stumbling through the office hallway, his skin turning pale grey with dark veins visible across his face and neck, eyes becoming milky white, suit torn, other office workers backing away in horror, flickering fluorescent lights

scenes.name: zombie_attacks_coworker
scenes.prompt: the now fully transformed zombie executive lunging at a terrified coworker in a cubicle, biting into the victim's shoulder, blood splattering on the computer monitor, the victim screaming in agony, office papers flying everywhere

scenes.name: office_chaos
scenes.prompt: a crowded office floor in total chaos, multiple freshly bitten workers convulsing on the ground as the infection spreads, people trampling each other trying to reach the elevators, overturned desks and shattered glass, emergency lights flashing red
